title: Meta stock falls 6%+ to a 10-month low after juries in two US trials found the company failed to adequately warn or protect young users (Harshita Mary Varghese/Reuters)
summary: Harshita Mary Varghese / Reuters: Meta stock falls 6%+ to a 10-month low after juries in two US trials found the company failed to adequately warn or protect young users — Meta (META.O) shares fell 6% to a 10-month low on Thursday after rulings this week found the Facebook parent failed to adequately warn or protect young users …
